items.title: Devfest Kano 2026
items.text:
Date: 5 December 2026, 08:00 UTC
Ends: 5 December 2026, 16:00 UTC
Location: Kano, kano
Registration: Free registration

Join us for the Devfest Kano 2026! Discover the exciting plans we have in store for this year's developer conference. Network with fellow tech enthusiasts and share your ideas. Don't miss this opportunity to shape the future of Devfest Kano.

RSVP now to secure your spot!
